programme.desc: It is Christmas Eve and the Silberhaus children are excited for the festivities to begin. Marie and Fritz are playing in the children's room when their godfather Drosselmayer arrives and presents them with an early Christmas gift, a Nutcracker. Marie witnesses a great battle between a vast army of toy soldiers led by the Nutcracker against a terrible platoon of mice commanded by the Mouse King. Follow Marie and Fritz's journey in the Kingdom of Dolls, through the Christmas Forest, past the Almond Milk Sea, and the Palace of the Marzipans.

programme.title: Last Days in the Desert
programme.desc: As Jesus begins his journey out of the wilderness following forty days of fasting and praying, he struggles with the Devil over the fate of a family in crisis. This powerful drama depicting an imagined chapter from Jesus' life stars Golden Globe winner Ewan McGregor (Trainspotting, Star Wars franchise), Academy Award nominee Ciarn Hinds (Belfast, Game of Thrones), and Tye Sheridan (Mud, X-Men franchise).

programme.title: How to Ruin the Holidays
programme.desc: A festive family caper starring Amber Nash (Archer, Mr. Robot) as a struggling comedian who reluctantly returns home for Christmas. Upon her arrival, she must not only deal with her eccentric and wildly dysfunctional family, but ultimately has a life-changing decision to make about her father and special-needs brother.

programme.title: Christmas at the Ranch
programme.desc: When Haley Hollis returns to her family ranch, she wasn't banking on spending so much time with with ranch hand Kate - or falling for her.

programme.title: Christmas Couple's Retreat
programme.desc: Three couples attend a retreat to strengthen their respective relationships under the guidance of a famed therapist. But as the holiday season unfolds, unexpected challenges arise when the therapist must confront some feelings of her own, and sparks fly when one couple's son unexpectedly falls for the charming retreat manager. Will this festive getaway reignite these couples' love, or will it lead them down an entirely new path?

programme.title: 12 Dogs of Christmas
programme.desc: A girl who uses dogs to teach people about the true meaning of Christmas during the Depression.

programme.title: Christmas With a Crown
programme.desc: When a successful woman returns to her hometown to revive her family's Christmas festival, she meets a dashing stranger who's volunteered to help organise the event. Sparks begin to fly between them, but little does she know that he's really a prince in disguise, longing to find the true spirit of the holidays! It will take a Christmas miracle of royal proportions for their hearts to meet as one.

programme.title: Joseph and Mary
programme.desc: During a time of much civil unrest, a holy man, Rabbi Elijah, swears an oath to protect the two young sons of a persecuted man. But while Jesus survives King Herod's slaughter of the innocents, it tragically claims the lives of the boys Elijah swore to protect.Seeking to avenge their deaths, he begins his quest for retribution. But when he meets Joseph, Mary and their young son Jesus, the anger that fuels his revenge is questioned. Elijah is faced with a life-changing choice: should he kill, or should he choose forgiveness, and in doing so, contradict every scripture upheld by his forefathers? With a powerful performance from Kevin Sorbo (Hercules, God's Not Dead), Joseph and Mary, is a stirring story of inspiration and hope, and of mercy versus revenge, set in the years before Jesus became the man who ultimately changed the course of humanity forever.

programme.title: 12 Days Of Giving
programme.desc: When Baxter Billings (David Blue - SGU Stargate Universe, Ugly Betty) wins a small fortune at his local shopping mall, he decides to become a Secret Santa to the people in his hometown. His anonymous philanthropy is contagious and soon enough the joy of giving at Christmas spreads across town. Along the way, Baxter forms a close friendship with Pamela (Ashley Jones - True Blood, The Bold and the Beautiful) and her young son Westin. He thinks he might be falling for Pamela... but there's one problem, he's already engaged! This Christmas, Baxter will have to choose between keeping promises or following his heart.

programme.title: Saving Santa
programme.desc: Once upon a time, Santa operated with just a small workshop and a few elves. But, as Christmas has grown ever bigger, Santa has been forced to innovate! Now his cleverest elves develop amazing technology, including a hologram to hide the North Pole and a time machine to allow Santa to deliver presents to every home in the world, in just the one night. Bernard is an elf who dreams of creating such inventions, but his job is to clean the reindeer stables! Yet when he creates an amazing Christmas memory machine, his luck might be changing. But Bernard's invention is broken by a curious elf, causing the North Pole's power to fail and the hologram hiding it to disappear. Now exposed to the outside world, it is spotted by Santa's enemy, Neville Baddington, who is determined to steal Santa's secrets for himself. The only person who can stop him is Bernard.

programme.title: The Magic Reindeer: The Flight Before Christmas
programme.desc: Niko the Reindeer enjoys his cool and carefree life in the Arctic, but that all changes when he is given his most surprising Christmas present ever - a little stepbrother named Jonni! Niko is unhappy about this new addition to the family, but when Jonni is kidnapped by eagles, Niko realises that it's down to him to fly off and rescue his brother!

programme.title: A Miracle on Christmas Lake
programme.desc: After the loss of his best friend on Christmas Eve, Bobby goes out onto the lake and makes a shocking discovery. When the land is bought, Bobby must rally the town to save it.

programme.title: A Christmas Kiss
programme.desc: A romantic drama in the backdrop of Christmas time in Wisconsin, revolving around two college sweethearts who rekindle their love during the holiday season

programme.title: You Can't Fight Christmas
programme.desc: Interior decorator and Christmas fanatic, Leslie Major, has the yearly task of decorating the lobby of the famed Chesterton Hotel. But one fateful day whilst working on a ladder to reach the top of the tree, she falls into the arms of Edmund James, the grandson of the hotel's owner. However, Edmund is all business and plans to put an end to the annual tradition. Can Leslie work her magic and teach him to love Christmas?

programme.title: Elf Man
programme.desc: An Elf is left behind by Santa to help rescue the Harper family from a lousy Christmas. The Elf and the family get more than they bargained for, as the kids help the Elf discover his special powers and true identity as a budding superhero.

programme.title: The Nights Before Christmas
programme.desc: In this Christmas set horror, a pair of crazed killers have written a very special 'naughty' list of targets. You better watch out, as now they've checked it twice, all sorts of festive hell is about to break loose! When a series of murders in the run up to Christmas are found to be linked, FBI Special Agent Natalie Parker is tasked with tracking a pair of psychotic serial killers. But she soon discovers the couple are not only crazy, having met in and escaped from an asylum for the criminally insane, but have based their personas on Santa and Mrs Claus. As Christmas approaches, they slaughter their way through their special naughty list, playing a cat and mouse game with the FBI and leaving a trail of gruesome bloody bodies in their wake.

programme.title: The Three Dogateers Save Christmas
programme.desc: When a couple of burglars make off with their family's presents and decorations, the Three Dogateers set off on a journey to sniff out the bad guys and save Christmas!

programme.title: Tangerine
programme.desc: It's Christmas Eve in Tinseltown and Sin-Dee (Kitana Kiki Rodriguez) is back on the block. Upon hearing that her pimp boyfriend (James Ransone) hasn't been faithful during the 28 days she was locked up, the working girl and her best friend, Alexandra (Mya Taylor), embark on a mission to get to the bottom of the scandalous rumour. Their rip-roaring odyssey leads them through various subcultures of Los Angeles, including an Armenian family dealing with their own repercussions of infidelity.

programme.title: Benji's Very Own Christmas Story
programme.desc: On a surprise visit to meet Kris Kringle, Benji and his friends are shocked to discover that he plans to take the night off on Christmas Eve!

programme.title: Santa Stole Our Dog
programme.desc: A magical holiday adventure featuring original Christmas songs by Dolly Parton, and starring Golden Globe winner, Ed Asner (Elf, Up). The Whitehaven family embark on a whirlwind adventure to the North Pole when their beloved dog, Rusty, goes missing on Christmas Eve.

programme.title: 12 Dogs of Christmas 2: Great Puppy Rescue
programme.desc: In this heartwarming sequel to the holiday classic, Emma (Danielle Chuchran) rallies her friends new and old to save a beloved puppy orphanage by putting on a musical holiday extravaganza.

programme.title: Christmas Ransom
programme.desc: In this festive comedy for the whole family, a pair of bumbling crooks break into a toy store on the verge of closing, and take the struggling owner hostage. Little do they know that two hideaway kids have also been locked in the store. With Christmas on the line, the kids team up with a heavily pregnant security officer in a series of hilarious and heartwarming escapades. Can they outwit the thieves and save both the store, and Christmas?

programme.title: On Angel Wings
programme.desc: One starry night, a shepherd boy is taken on a secret, magical night-flight to witness a Christmas miracle. Rachel is 8 and for the first time is allowed to join her brothers and sister to visit their grandfather, Amos, as he carries out his annual ritual of a night in the hills, where he worked as a young shepherd boy. Grandfather is delighted to see the children and a special bond is established between him and Rachel. He tells them how she reminds him of a magical night; he then proceeds to recount it. He explains how, ahead of the other shepherds protecting their flock with him, he is flown away by the Angel Gabriel, to be the first visitor to the newly born Christ child. This magical re-working of the nativity by the leading writer Michael Morpurgo (War Horse, Private Peaceful) is rich with human poignancy as we share this very special experience.

programme.title: Christmas Miracle (2014)
programme.desc: It's Christmas Eve in the sleepy town of Rockford when Sheriff Rick Langston (Dean Cain, Lois & Clarke: The New Adventures of Superman) arrests a mysterious man who resembles Santa Claus. However, when the townspeople's Christmas wishes all start to come true, the sheriff begins to wonder if this jolly old man just might be the real deal. It is when he is out of love and luck and at his most cynical that the sheriff meets Lucy (Christine Lakin, Valentine\s Day) and is shown the miracle of love and family. As Christmas Day fast approaches, new relationships are forged and existing ties are strengthened in this uplifting festival story for the whole family.

programme.title: TikTok: Murder Gone Viral
programme.desc: With exclusive access to the victims' families, friends and the police, this documentary strand explores extraordinary true crime cases linked to the world's fastest-growing social media platform. TikTok influencer Alexis Sharkey seemed to have the perfect life - she regularly posted videos to her 80,000 followers, but all this came to a sudden end when she disappeared in November 2020. Her parents and friends became increasingly worried and reported her missing - on the 28th of November, 2020, a rubbish truck driver spotted a naked body dumped in the gutter of a side road in Houston. The police confirmed that it was Alexis and revealed that the 26-year-old had been strangled to death - detectives then began a murder investigation and news of the popular influencer's death went viral on TikTok. Just two weeks after Alexis was found dead, her husband Tom also disappeared - however, two of the influencer's closest friends revealed that Alexis had said that she was being abused by him.

programme.title: Inside the Asylum Camp
programme.desc: Mass accommodation sites are central to the government's plan to end the use of asylum hotels. This undercover investigation goes inside Crowborough, a former military training camp now housing asylum seekers. Filming covertly, the programme investigates conditions inside the site, finding how systemically poor welfare checks are having serious consequences. The film also examines the local community's response to asylum seekers being housed in the town, including a network of surveillance set up by local groups to monitor the camp's residents whenever they leave the site. It also looks at instances of intimidation towards people helping the new arrivals.

programme.title: The Assembly
programme.desc: Aitch faces the grilling of a lifetime from a cast of autistic and learning-disabled interviewers. What's his PIN number? How much does his watch cost? What's so good about Manchester? From the moment he enters the room, nothing is off limits. As the questions come thick and fast, Aitch reflects on his lyrics and the language he used early in his career, admitting he felt pressure to say certain things as a young rapper - and that he got it wrong. He opens up about fame, identity and the nuances of being a white rapper in a typically black scene, as well as the values that matter most to him now. Along the way, there are questions about first dates and apologies, with time for a tour of his tattoos and the story of standing up for his sister. In a deeply moving moment, he shares what he hopes for her future, and admits he's still figuring out how to calm his mind when things feel overwhelming. From big laughs to real vulnerability, this is Aitch as you've never seen him before.

In an effort to feel better, she reconnects with her half-sister Grace, (Lauren Fales) and, inspired by a new boyfriend (Brian Rieger), sets out on a quest to find someone to help. programme.title: The Past Never Dies
programme.desc: CASEY MARSH was born in captivity. Her mother, JANE, was abducted as a teenager and gave birth to Casey while she was being held by the kidnapper, TIMOTHY FAST. Jane eventually escaped when Casey was 6 years old. Timothy Fast was arrested and incarcerated. Ever since, Jane has struggled to regain a normal life for her and her daughter. For Casey, the memories of a childhood in captivity still haunt her. Jane, on the other hand, has seemingly moved on. She has re-married and is happy. When a number of local women start to go missing, Jane reveals to Casey that Timothy might have had an accomplice and wonders if he is involved. The kidnapping M.O. is eerily similar. Casey is furious that her mother has hidden this knowledge from her all this time. Then, Jane suddenly disappears. Has she been kidnapped again? Casey must face the demons of her past in order to find her mother before it’s too late.

programme.title: Jewish Gis
programme.desc: Jewish GIs of WWII tells the profound and unique story of the 550,000 Jewish men and women who served in World War II. Held as POWs and awarded honours for merit and valour, thousands were wounded and 11,000 were killed in action. Ten thousand Jewish women joined up as well, disregarding their parents' warnings that the military 'was no life for a nice Jewish girl'. In the midst of it all, they fought a second, more private battle against anti-Semitism within the ranks. They endured slurs and even violence from their fellow servicemen, and often felt forced to prove their courage and patriotism. Jewish Americans earned their citizenship by shedding blood, leaving their outsider status behind.

programme.title: The Joker
programme.desc: In this creepy and twisted thriller, a young detective is caught in a horrifically sadistic game of cat-and-mouse when he is kidnapped and tormented by a masked, sex-crazed, serial killer. With a deadly race against time, he only has one method to save himself and a young girl. Starring Ron Perlman (Hellboy) and Halston Sage (Bad Neighbours) this clever, nail-biting nightmare is not to be missed!

programme.title: Escape Room
programme.desc: A mind-bending psychological thriller about a group of friends who find themselves in a sadistic, living nightmare. Six adventurous strangers travel to a mysterious building to experience a game where players compete to solve puzzles to win money. But what starts out as innocent fun soon turns into a suffocating and terrifying game of hell.

programme.title: The Dark
programme.desc: FrightFest Presents. Hailed by critics as the best horror film in recent memory, The Dark is a haunting and deeply intense atmospheric film about love, monsters and revenge that is being compared to the spine-chilling Let The Right One In. Mina stalks the forest that saw her murder. Anyone who enters, become her feast. But when she meets a young boy, she becomes his protector.

programme.title: A Kid Like Jake
programme.desc: A heart-breaking family drama starring Claire Danes, Jim Parsons and Octavia Spencer. Parents, Alex and Greg are approaching an important crossroads - finding the "right" primary school for their son, Jake, a precocious four-year-old who happens to prefer Disney princesses to G.I. Joe. However, as Jake's behaviour becomes increasingly erratic and perplexing, a rift begins to emerge between them.

programme.title: JT Leroy
programme.desc: A captivating retelling of one of the literary worlds most infamous hoaxes. Laura Albert (Laura Dern) writes as her avatar, a disenfranchised young queer man named JT LeRoy. When her novel becomes a best-seller, she wants to remain anonymous. Enter her boyfriends androgynous sister Savannah (Kristen Stewart), who agrees to be JT in the public eye.

programme.title: Adventurer: The Curse of the Midas Box
programme.desc: Transporting you to a rollicking, rambunctious realm of enchanting fantasy, featuring Sam Neill (Jurassic Park) and Lena Headey (Game of Thrones). When Mariah's younger brother is kidnapped, he follows a trail of clues to discover a hidden realm of child-stealing monsters, ancient secrets and a long-lost artefact. Will our fearless hero save the fate of the world from evil? A magical must see!

programme.title: Arthur and Merlin
programme.desc: A spectacular fantasy-epic, recounting the legendary adventures of two iconic characters. In Dark Ages Britain, a time of myth and magic, a Saxon force from the East attacks the Celtic people. However, hope is not lost when Arthur, a banished warrior, and Merlin, a hermit wizard, embark on a heroic quest to save their people. A mystic and mythical tale of courage and valour.

programme.title: Before You Know It
programme.desc: An unmissable New-York- based “dramedy” in the vein of Woody Allen. Stage manager Rachel (Hannah Pearl Utt) is the only thing standing between her family and utter chaos. She then discovers that her presumed-dead mother (Judith Light: Transparent) is alive and thriving as a soap-opera star! Also starring, Mike Colter (Luke Cage) and Alec Baldwin (It’s Complicated). Funny and moving!

programme.title: Mythica: A Quest for Heroes
programme.desc: An epic fantasy adventure that will thrill Game Of Thrones fans. Mythica follows the enchanting adventures of a wizard born with dark powers, trapped in a life of eternal servitude. On fleeing her violent master she assembles a team of adventurers to embark on an heroic quest to rescue a warriors sister from a vicious Ogre. This action-packed adventure has our seal of approval!

programme.title: 13 Minutes
programme.desc: An edge-of-your-seat disaster thriller featuring an incredible cast, including Amy Smart (The Butterfly Effect), Thora Birch (American Beauty), Peter Facinelli (Twilight franchise) and Anne Heche (Volcano) and boasting jaw-dropping visual effects from the team behind Everest. The largest tornado on record threatens to ravage a small town, leaving residents with only 13 minutes to find shelter.

programme.title: Southern Fury
programme.desc: Take a trip to the Deep South in this gruelling crime thriller, starring Nicolas Cage, John Cusack and Adrian Grenier. When a ruthless crime boss kidnaps his mobster brother Mikey, JP must go against the odds, out-ranked and out-gunned to save his brothers life. With his brothers old detective pal Sal by his side, they now face an army of relentless war-thirsty gangsters.

programme.title: We Summon The Darkness
programme.desc: FrightFest Presents: Summer 1998: three boys, three girls, one hell of a night. Turn the music up and let the blood flow as ritual sacrifice becomes the ultimate party game, starring Alexandra Daddario, Maddie Hassan and Johnny Knoxville. Delightfully madcap, zany and enjoyable, with exceptionally entertaining characters, this horror-comedy will bring the (satanic) house down!

programme.title: Superbob
programme.desc: Superbob is a hilarious and touching new twist on the superhero genre starring legendary British comedian Catherine Tate (The Office). 7 years ago Robert Kenner, a mild mannered postman from Peckham, South London was struck by a meteor which bestowed him with super powers. 6 years later, Bob finally gets a day off from his superhero duties and tries to get a shot at love

programme.title: A Good Woman is Hard to Find
programme.desc: A dynamic killer thriller, firmly on the pulses of stark social commentary, Abner Pastoll (director of Road Games) crafts a dazzling, dark and daring journey through Northern Irelands criminal underbelly. Widowed Sarah (tour de force Sarah Bolger: Emelie) is desperate to know who murdered her husband. Coerced into helping a drug-dealer, she takes drastic action to protect her kids.

programme.title: A Good Woman is Hard to Find
programme.desc: A dynamic killer thriller, firmly on the pulses of stark social commentary, Abner Pastoll (director of Road Games) crafts a dazzling, dark and daring journey through Northern Irelands criminal underbelly. Widowed Sarah (tour de force Sarah Bolger: Emelie) is desperate to know who murdered her husband. Coerced into helping a drug-dealer, she takes drastic action to protect her kids.

programme.title: The Night Eats The World
programme.desc: Eerie and atmospheric - a refreshing addition to the popular zombie genre. Waking up in an apartment after a raging party, Sam is forced to come to grips with reality when discovering the living dead have invaded the streets of Paris. Alone and petrified with fear, Sam is barricades himself inside the building and organises his survival. But is he really the sole survivor?

programme.title: Bloodthirsty
programme.desc: Frightfest Presents. Ambition can be killer. When an offer to work with one of the greatest music producers of all time comes along, singer Grey cant refuse but her new mentor isnt all that he seems to be. Moving to record her album in a remote location, Grey realises theres a beastly secret lurking. Will her humanity be the price for fame and how much blood will be shed to secure a hit?

programme.title: Initiation
programme.desc: Carefree partying turns sinister in this edgy slasher that sees Whiton University unravel on the night a star-athlete is murdered in the wake of a buried assault allegation. As a masked killer targets students, a trio of sorority sisters race to uncover the schools dark secrets. Starring Yancy Butler (Kick-Ass), Lochlyn Munro (Riverdale) and Jon Huertas (This Is Us).

programme.title: Fall of a Kingdom
programme.desc: Game of Thrones meets Braveheart. This historical actioner follows a 13th century freedom fighters as they battle for their lives and liberty in the face of the brutal Mongolian Empire. As war breaks out, both sides suffer devastation. Redoubling his efforts, Burunda Khan the Mongolian general - unleashes the full fury of his force. Starring Robert Patrick, Tommy Flanagan and Poppy Drayton.

programme.title: The Adventures of Maid Marian
programme.desc: Everyone knows the stories of Robin Hood and Maid Marian; robbing from the rich to give to the poor, daring escapes from the evil Sheriff, sword fights and adventures. They eventually culminate in the arrival of King Richard the Lionheart who grants the outlaw a royal pardon. Most of the stories end here. This is the story of what happens next. A legend returns to save her people again...

programme.title: Jellyfish
programme.desc: Hailed as this yearÕs breakout British drama, Jellyfish boasts an incredible performance from BAFTA nominee Liv Hill. SarahÕs life as a young carer has turned her into a teenage terror. When her teacher helps her channel her ferocious wit into stand-up comedy, her lifeÕs delicate balance is set on a collision course. A sincere look at a young woman who, against all odds finds her voice.

programme.title: Proximity
programme.desc: Close Encounters of the Third Kind meets Independence Day. Earth is in danger and Isaac holds the key to unravelling the mystery that will expose the truth behind alien abduction. Once an unpopular cog in the machine of life; Isaac now finds himself a wanted man and the only person that stands between human extinction at the hands of an extra-terrestrial threat. An invasion is coming!

programme.title: A Call to Spy
programme.desc: Inspired by incredible true stories. At the beginning of WWII Churchill orders his new spy agency to recruit women as spies to build a resistance. SOEs spymistress Vera Atkins (Stana Katic), recruits Virginia Hall (Sarah Megan Thomas), an ambitious American with a wooden leg and Noor Inayat Khan (Radhika Apte), a Muslim pacifist, who leave an unmistakable legacy in their wake.

programme.title: Image of Victory
programme.desc: A thought-provoking war thriller based on true events. In 1948, Cairo, Egypt. Hassanin, a young and idealistic Egyptian documentary filmmaker, travels with a Muslim Brotherhood platoon to the holy land. The mission: help Palestinian villagers who have been evicted by newcomer Israelis. But when Hassanin is tasked with documenting a raid on an isolated kibbutz, his values are tested to the extreme.

programme.title: Bad Samaritan
programme.desc: David Tennant (Doctor Who) and Robert Sheehan (Misfits) star in this dark, twisty mind games thriller. Struggling artist Sean who has a sideline in burglary, hits the jackpot when he breaks into the luxurious home of the wealthy Cale. But when Sean discovers a woman chained up in the house, he is soon dangerously embroiled in a vicious game of cat and mouse with a merciless psychopath.

programme.title: American Fighter
programme.desc: A high-octane, edge-of-your-seat action thriller starring Tommy Flanagan (Sons of Anarchy), Sean Patrick Flanery (Dexter) and newcomer George Kosturos. Boasting many gritty and excellently choreographed fight scenes, reminiscent of cult classics Rocky and The Karate Kid. A desperate teenager is forced into the dangerous world of underground fighting to win enough money to save his ailing mother.

programme.title: Death Trench
programme.desc: In the final days of WWI a shell-shocked tunneller leads an Allied team into a hidden German base... one hundred feet below the trenches. The Germans have lost control of a highly contagious biological weapon that turns its victims into deranged killers. The Allies find themselves trapped underground with hordes of the infected, a rapidly spreading disease and a team of German Stormtroopers dispatched to clean up the mess

programme.title: True Crime Stories | Ty Notts
programme.sub-title: Burned Alive By Her Friends | Shanda Sharer
programme.desc: It was 1992 and Shanda Sharer was just 12-years-old. She’d recently moved to a new school and was having trouble with one particular girl who just wouldn’t leave her alone. The girl would send Shanda countless threatening letters, with each letter growing more and more violent than the last. This all culminated in one seriously disturbing crime that investigators simply couldn’t understand. Shanda would eventually go missing, but two of her so-called “friends” would soon make a shocking confession that no one could have seen coming. Detectives were left speechless, questioning how a few teenage girls could have such twisted minds and carry out a crime of such vile and repulsive proportions. This is one story you won’t want to miss. This true crime documentary from 2023 will give you chills. Missing persons cases like this are often not solved years later.

programme.title: True Crime Stories | Ty Notts
programme.sub-title: My Son Murdered My Daughter | Paris Bennett & Ella Bennett
programme.desc: 13-year-old Paris Bennet was at home with his 4-year-old sister, Ella in Abilene, Texas. Their mother had hired a babysitter to watch over the two for the evening, but at some point during her stay, Paris had convinced the babysitter to step out of the house for a while. About an hour and a half later, Paris entered his sister’s bedroom to commit an unthinkable, and his sister lost her life. Around fifteen minutes later, Paris called the police and concocted a alibi, claiming his sister had turned into a pumpkin-headed demon, and that he had claimed her life out of fear and self-defense. But when investigators arrived at the scene of the crime minutes later, it became clear what had taken place here. Paris was obviously arrested, but the stories he told investigators were… chilling to say the least; and his true motive was completely unexpected. This true crime documentary from 2023 will give you chills. Missing persons cases like this are often not solved years later.

programme.title: True Crime Stories | Ty Notts
programme.sub-title: Her Brother Revealed Her Killer | Holly Bobo
programme.desc: This is the true crime case of Holly Bobo, a young woman from Darden, Tennessee who lost her life at the hands of three terrifying criminals in Parsons, Tennessee. This true crime documentary from 2023 will give you chills. Missing persons cases like this are often not solved years later.

programme.title: True Crime Stories | Ty Notts
programme.sub-title: He Knew His Family’s Killer | Chris Benoit
programme.desc: Chris Benoit was a professional wrestler and WWE star. In June of 2007, investigators discovered an eerie crime scene at Chris Benoit's home, in which his entire family had lost their lives. The scary thing was, their only suspect was someone that detectives could have never expected. This true crime documentary from 2023 will give you chills. Chilling cases like this are often not solved years later.

programme.title: True Crime Stories | Ty Notts
programme.sub-title: Mysterious Ring Revealed Her Killer? | Danyese LaClair
programme.desc: Danyese LaClair suddenly went missing after investigators found her abandoned vehicle at a post office in Burton, Michigan. Her case remains unsolved, but a chilling piece of evidence found at the scene of the crime has left detectives baffled for decades. This true crime documentary from 2023 will give you chills. Missing persons cases like this are often not solved years later.

programme.title: True Crime Stories | Ty Notts
programme.sub-title: My Neighbor Ate My Son | Michael Woodmansee
programme.desc: The year is 1975. For the Foreman family, life was moving along perfectly; they had two wonderful kids, they were young and deeply in love, and everything was looking up. But on Mrs. Foreman's 25th birthday, tragedy would strike. As her 5-year-old son, Jason Foreman, was playing outside in the woods near their home, he disappeared. The family and nearby neighbors searched for the missing boy for hours, days, weeks, and eventually years. They found no clues or evidence that would explain Jason Foreman's sudden disappearance. The missing boy wouldn’t be found until more than 7 years later when investigators met with a neighbor, Michael Woodmansee, who made a truly disgusting confession to a crime of devastating proportions. programme.title: The Nanny
programme.desc: Though excited to learn that she will be working on Christmas Day, Fran is surprised to hear that Maxwell will be producing a benefit in Washington D.C. Told that the Sheffields will celebrate Christmas one day early, Fran is further disappointed to find that Maxwell farms out all of his gift buying to a personal shopper. So, upon finding that the children don't believe in Santa and that what Grace really wants is to have her father home on Christmas, Fran decides to have a talk with Maxwell -- until Niles points out that he is preparing the staff s Christmas bonuses. Revealing that C.C. will also be joining him in Washington but insisting that their trip will be all business, Maxwell is nonetheless persuaded to do his own shopping for a change. So, when Fran relies on Niles' assessment of her bonus and buys the children some expensive gifts, she discovers that, instead of money, Maxwell bought her a beautiful vase. Faced with having to either take back her gifts or somehow pay the bill, Fran declines Niles' offer of a loan and goes to see Val's Uncle Paulie to pawn the vase. But, when Maxwell mentions it later, Fran guiltily rushes to buy it back and, forced to pay twice what she got, sells her grandmother's watch instead. Receiving a call from Niles with word about Fran and the watch, Maxwell decides to make things right. So, leaving C.C. behind at the airport, he intercepts the family at St. Patrick's Cathedral and finds Fran in a confessional seeking help with her financial difficulties. Finally, after returning the watch and then accidentally sitting on the vase, Maxwell ends up at the hospital being treated for his wounds, while Grace gets her wish and renews her belief in Santa Claus.

programme.desc: A young and talented chef, ALICE (Meggan Kaiser), works as a sous chef at one of the top restaurants in New York. programme.title: Romance In The Air
programme.desc: After learning her marketing job is on the line, Eden returns to Lake Tahoe where she used to spend her summers growing up. Intending to relax and recharge so she can tackle her job again, she is surprised to find her childhood friend and sweetheart Riley is still living next door. She finds purpose in helping Riley propel his struggling hot air balloon tour company, and also finds herself drawn to him and their dear past. However, Eden sees Riley and Tahoe as temporary, while her life—and boyfriend—back home await her. She can’t admit that she and Riley could have a future, even if that’s exactly what she wants. When she’s willing to take a risk for what her heart wants, her life will take off with her true love.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Welcome to Ukraine and the wonderful capital city of Kyiv. Were here for the second time for the iconic truck pull World Championships! The reigning World champion Kelvin de Ruiter from Holland will defend his title.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: In this episode, a final chance for our athletes to get vital world series ranking points on board to give them the best possible chance of success and an initial advantage at the finals. It's the last show before the world finals and the top 10 places are up for grabs, but who will they be?

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: We are in Alanya, on Turkeys south-coast for the final stop at the end of a mammoth season. Here in the sunshine, well finally crown our world champion and what a place Alanya is - you could not ask for a better setting. Aivars Smaukstellis, the reigning world champion is defending his title, and two-time world champion Dainis Zageris is also here, but with a though competition, who will win?

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: What a day ahead of us here in Alanya, just a handful of events to go before we find out who will be the winner of Strongman Champions League in 2021. These are the world finals, and all the big names are in the house. With just 3 events to go - who will take the crown of World Champion 2021 and be the STRONGEST?

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: We are back, after a short break it feels like we never even left. We’re here in Vaasa - Finland kicking off 2022 new world series. If you are watching at home, just like these people, you’re in the right place. Because this is a special edition world record breaker. The only question left today, is to see how many new world records will be set so stay tuned.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: We are here in Doetinchem – Holland, for Stage 2 and 3 in the hottest day of the year. 40-degree heat, these boys have to work harder than they ever have. The sun is going to be beating down, they’re going to be sweating, hydration is going to be key today. I also reckon they’re all going to be wearing their sunglasses. Let’s see which shady looking character wins.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: So there you have it. The next day, 3 more events in 40 Degrees heat. We’ve got Gavin coming into day 2 leading the pack. Kelvin De Ruiter our world champion struggling a little bit at the moment, but Yoke Race, Conan’s Wheel and then Stones to finish. programme.title: The Lawless Years
programme.desc: The Maxie Gorman Story. 1959. Stars James Gregory, Robert H. Harris & Terence de Marney. Two men join forces to get into the bootlegging business but one man does not want to split the profits.

programme.title: Madron
programme.desc: 1970. Western. Director: Jerry Hopper. Stars Richard Boone, Leslie Caron & Gabi Amrani. A gunfighter and a French-Canadian nun who survived a massacre, set out on a trek to elude Apache warriors. [S]

programme.title: The Better Milk Story
programme.desc: A short film about JOBS Dairy. Meet the free range cows and learn about the milking methods, from the field to the doorstep in 1962!

programme.title: Batman
programme.desc: An Egg Grows in Gotham. 1966. Stars Adam West, Vincent Price & Edward Everett Horton. Egghead and his yeggs steal the Gotham City charter in a twisted plot to gain control of the city. [S]

programme.title: Batman
programme.desc: The Yegg Foes in Gotham. 1966. Stars Adam West, Vincent Price & Gail Hire. The city's ownership has reverted to Egghead, who fires all city officials and opens the metropolis to the underworld. [S]

programme.title: Theirs Is The Glory
programme.desc: 1946. War. Director: Brian Desmond Hurst. The story of the armies' heroic struggle to hold the vital Arnheim Bridge during World War II. Over 200 veterans took part, although no credits appear. [S]

programme.title: It's a Great Day
programme.desc: 1955. Starring Ruth Dunning, Edward Evans, Sidney James, Sheila Sweet, Peter Bryant, Nancy Roberts and Vera Day. Comedy based on the hugely successful TV series 'The Groves'. [S]

programme.title: Anna Christie
programme.desc: 1930. Drama. Director: Clarence Brown. Stars Greta Garbo & Charles Bickford. A young woman reunites with her father and falls in love with a sailor but struggles to tell them about her dark past. [S]

programme.title: For The Love of Benji
programme.desc: 1977. Director: Joe Camp. Stars Patsy Garrett, Cynthia Smith, Peter Bowles & Art Vasil. A lovable canine gets caught up in an international espionage plot while on a family vacation in Greece.

programme.title: Four Star Playhouse: The Man...
programme.desc: ...Who Walked Out On Himself. 1953. Stars Ronald Colman & Francis Pierlot. A wealthy clubman leaves his family to marry a much younger woman, prompting his mirror image to walk out on him. [S]

programme.title: William Tell
programme.desc: The Traitor. 1959. Stars Conrad Phillips & Jennifer Jayne. The leader of a resistance group sends for Tell and Hedda to help him weed out a traitor but they soon find out they are in a trap. [S]

programme.title: The Large Rope
programme.desc: (AKA: The Long Rope). 1953. Drama. Director: Wolf Rilla. Stars Donald Houston, Susan Shaw & Peter Byrne. A man returns to where he was accused of murdering a girl to prove his innocence. [S]

programme.title: Turn The Key Softly
programme.desc: 1953. Drama. Director: Jack Lee. Stars Yvonne Mitchell, Joan Collins, Kathleen Harrison. Three women are released from Holloway prison on the same morning into the bustle of post-war London. [S]

programme.title: Give Us A Clue
programme.desc: 1985. The classic game show Give us a Clue hosted by Michael Parkinson, this week's guests are, George Melly, Jane Asher and William Franklin, Nerys Hughes, Fred Trueman and Rosalind Ayres. [S]

programme.title: Ghost Ship
programme.desc: 1953. Thriller. Directed by Vernon Sewell. Starring Hazel Court & Dermot Walsh. A young couple decide to buy a luxury steamboat for a romantic getaway and scoff at warnings that it's haunted. [S]

programme.title: None But the Tortoise (1966)
programme.desc: A short documentary from 1966 detailing the car crowded roads of London and the changes that have come into play to make the roads more efficient.

programme.title: The Man from U.N.C.L.E
programme.desc: The Birds and the Bees Affair. 1966. Stars Robert Vaughn, David McCallum & Ahna Capri. THRUSH has developed a strain of tiny but deadly bees and plans to release them in U.N.C.L.E. HQ in New York. [S]

programme.title: Hannay
programme.desc: The Fellowship of the Black Stone. 1988. Stars Robert Powell, Christopher Scoular & Gavin Richards. Hannay is recognised as an officer in military intelligence, an engineer & a prospector. [S]

programme.title: Bellman and True
programme.desc: 1987. Thriller. Directed by Richard Loncraine. Stars Bernard Jill, Derek Newark & Richard Hope. A computer expert is forced to use his scientific genius to pull off a daring bank heist. [S]

programme.title: The Comic
programme.desc: 1969. Comedy/Drama. Directed by Carl Reiner. Stars Dick Van Dyke, Michele Lee & Mickey Rooney. The intriguing story of an exceptional silent-film comic whose talent is overshadowed by his ego. [S]

programme.desc: Yusei, who got back his Duel Runner and his Deck, continued his Turbo Duel with Trudge. Blister, who is witnessing the Turbo Duel, does not understand why Yusei is so determined to retrieve his "Bonds of Friendship".

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! 5 D's
programme.desc: Yusei Fudo is left unconscious after his harsh Duel with Trudge. The twins Leo and Luna rescue him. After Yusei regains consciousness, Leo demands a Duel with him. Meanwhile, Trudge waits outside in the hopes of capturing Yusei.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! 5 D's
programme.desc: Yusei Fudo decides to enter the Fortune Cup, after Lazar blackmailed him to do so, if he wants to see his friends at Satellite alive. On his way, he meets up with his old friends from the Facility, Bolt Tanner and Yanagi and his new friend, Leo at the Daimon Area. Leo and his friend Dexter went to the Daimon Area in order to challenge the mysterious Black Rose.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! 5 D's
programme.desc: The Fortune Cup has now begun. The first Duel is Luna vs. Greiger. But since Luna doesn't want to participate, Leo disguises himself and Duels in her place.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! 5 D's
programme.desc: Luna and Dexter try to cheer up Leo after his loss to Greiger. They approach Yusei, who tells him the experience he got from losing should prove useful later on. Leo encourages Yusei to win, just before Akiza passes them. She glares intensely at Yusei as she passes. The other three quickly step out of her way. Leo wonders what her problem is.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ARC-V
programme.desc: With the Friendship Cup about to kick off, Yuya learns about tournament champion Jack’s rise to the Tops!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ARC-V
programme.desc: The first duel of the Friendship Cup has the green light as Crow and Gong put the pedal to the metal!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ARC-V
programme.desc: Riley’s been chosen to Turbo Duel Shinji, but the battle hits a speedbump when Yuya steps in to stop the duel and keep his pint-sized pal in one piece!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ZEXAL
programme.desc: It all comes down to this! Yuma squares off against Vetrix in a battle that will determine the first ever World Duel Carnival Champion! Can Yuma figure out a way to outduel Vetrix, or will Vetrix and his devastating deck destroy Yuma’s chance of being a champion?!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ZEXAL
programme.desc: As the duel between Vetrix and Yuma races to its cataclysmic conclusion, Yuma stares down defeat and comes face-to-face with Vetrix’s shocking secret!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ZEXAL
programme.desc: This is it! The earth-shattering ending of Yuma’s duel against Vetrix! Can Yuma rise above Vetrix’s unrelenting onslaught, or will he meet defeat and lose everything he holds dear – his soul, his Numbers and… Astral?

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ZEXAL
programme.desc: Yuma learns the details of Dr. Faker’s diabolical plan to destroy Astral World! Can Yuma figure out a way to stop Faker, or is the future of Astral World a thing of the past?

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ARC-V
programme.desc: For Shinji to inspire the Commons to stand up to the Topsiders, he must first take down Moon Shadow! Can Shinji’s monsters swarm together and deliver the sting of defeat, or will Moon Shadow’s ninjas silence all the buzz?

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ARC-V
programme.desc: Yuya can't believe his eyes when he finds himself standing face-to-face-to-face with two lookalikes who are out to destroy each other... and everything in sight!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ARC-V
programme.desc: Yuya is in a coma, and nothing has been able to stir him from his terrifying state! Is Yuya down for the count, or will his duelmate's ESP and TLC make him A-OK?

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ARC-V
programme.desc: When a mysterious visitor threatens to throw the Championship into chaos, Declan moves in to uncover who they are and soon finds himself facing off against a merciless mercenary!
